mezmur_data_import.title: Amanuel Temesgen
mezmur_data_import.description: This mezmur is a deep expression of repentance and gratitude to Christ (Emmanuel) for His mercy. It reflects on human weakness and constant sin, acknowledging that if God were to judge strictly, no one could stand. Instead, it praises His compassion for covering sins and showing patience despite repeated failures. The chant expresses weariness from a sinful life and a longing for deliverance, recognizing that sin may seem appealing but leads to bitterness. Ultimately, it gives thanks to God for His forgiveness and love, declaring that gratitude is the only fitting response to His mercy.

mezmur_data_import.title: Behazene
mezmur_data_import.description: This mezmur is a heartfelt plea to the Virgin Mary for comfort and help during times of sorrow and distress. It expresses deep personal pain, loneliness, and spiritual struggle, while seeking refuge in her compassion. The chant portrays the believer as broken and hopeless in the eyes of the world, yet still holding onto faith through her intercession. Ultimately, it reflects trust in her mercy as a loving mother who supports her children in their weakest moments.

mezmur_data_import.title: By the Lord's grand design
mezmur_data_import.description: This mezmur reflects the divine order and sovereignty of God over all creation. It emphasizes that everything in existence is part of God’s perfect plan and design, both in heaven and on earth. The chant reassures believers that in every season—joy or sorrow—God is guiding all things for good for those who love Him. It highlights trust in God’s will, the beauty of creation, and the peace found in relying on His perfect purpose.

We honor exalt Him His promises we keep

In His perfect canvas there’s no flaw to be rid

He feels our despair and joys that have lighted

In joy and in sorrow His true purpose we find

mezmur_data_import.title: Cana of Galilee
mezmur_data_import.description: This mezmur reflects the miracle of Christ at Cana of Galilee, where He turned water into wine during a wedding. It highlights the intercession of the Holy Virgin Mary, her role in presenting the need to Christ, and the blessing that comes when Christ is present in a home. The chant emphasizes faith, divine power, humility, and the overflowing blessings that come through God’s presence.

Ultimately, it is a humble cry for forgiveness, renewal, and salvation before the final judgment.

The singer acknowledges a hardened heart, inconsistency between actions and faith, and a life shaken away from true Christian values. With deep humility and repentance, it asks God to correct, heal, and strengthen the soul. It also reflects hope in God as the firm foundation and loving shepherd who guides and restores. Ultimately, it is a plea for renewal, stability in faith, and the ability to glorify God once again.

It expresses trust in God’s mercy, His readiness to hear prayers, and His power to rescue from sin, fear, and despair. It emphasizes faith, repentance, and unwavering trust in God’s saving power.

It also speaks about spiritual awakening, transformation through divine encounters, and the power of God’s covenantal greeting.

It reflects on biblical moments such as the sinful woman who washed Christ’s feet and the calling of Zacchaeus, showing how Christ lifts the rejected and forgives sins. Drawing from scripture, it highlights courage in the face of persecution, trust in God's ultimate authority, and the victory of Christ over the world. The chant also honors martyrdom, affirming that those who sacrifice for their faith will be rewarded in God's eternal kingdom.

Through poetic praise, the faithful honor her as the fulfillment of biblical types and approach her with reverence, asking for her blessings and intercession.

It highlights her purity, her prophetic symbolism as the closed gate seen by Ezekiel, and her role as a source of peace and comfort. The chant emphasizes her intercession, portraying her as a constant presence who supports and consoles believers. It calls the faithful to honor her with continual praise and to entrust their lives to her care.

local_csv_mezmurs.title: Tabor Abera
local_csv_mezmurs.lyrics_amharic:

እኛም ከገናናው ክብር ያባቱን ቃል ሰምተናል
በረዶ ሆኗል ልብሱ እፁብ እፁብ ብለናል

ቃል ገብተህልኝ ነበር ልታሳየኝ ክብርህን
ንገስ ከሞት ገስግሰህ አይቼሃለሁ አሁን
የእሳት ፈረሶች አሉህ ተዋጊው የኔ ጌታ
አርሞንኤም ደስ አለው ሲሳራን ስለመታ

እጠብቅሃለሁኝ በምታልፍበት ቆሜ
መብራቶቼን አብርቼ ነጩን ልብስ ተሸልሜ
የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ ግባ ኢየሱስ ወደ ቤቴ
ጵንኤል እልሀለሁ ድናለች ሰውነቴ

ሁሉንም ብታከብር ሁሉንም ብትምረው
ማነው ቸርነትህን የሚከለክለው
ጠዋትም የተጠራ አምሽቶ የገባው
ሆነዋል ባለዋጋ ከበዛው ስጦታው

የረዳኸው ይናገር ያሰብከው በሕይወቱ
አቤነዘር እያለ ይዘምር ባንደበቱ
በደስታዬም ቀን አለህ አይሃለሁ ከጎኔ

ሥራህን ለትውልድ ለመመስከር
እኔ ማነኝ ብዬ አስባለሁ
አምላክ ቸርነትህን አደንቃለሁ

በሰው እጅ መመካት አቁሜያለሁ

local_csv_mezmurs.title: Misiganayen
local_csv_mezmurs.lyrics_amharic:
ምስጋናዬን ለአምላኬ አቀርባሁ
በማደሪያው ገብቼ እሰግድለታለሁ
ኤልሻዳይ ነው ጌታ ሁሉን ቻይ
ይፈጸማል አምናለሁ የልቤ ጉዳይ /2/

ዘንባባዬን ይዤ እንደ ሕፃናቱ
ሆሳዕና ልበለው ሰግጄ በፊቱ
ምንም ባዶ ብሆን እውቀት ቢጎድለኝም
ለስሙ ልዘምር ከልካይም የለኝም /2/

አምላኬ በፊትህ ቃል አለብኝ እኔ
ቋንቋዬ መዝሙር ነው ያንተ እንደመሆኔ
በአሚናዳብ ደጃፍ በቅድመ ታቦቱ
ያ የክብርህ ዑደት ጠራኝ ማኅሌቱ /2/

የሕይወት ትርጉሜ አንተ ነህ ደስታዬ
ስምህን ማገልገል ክብሬ ነው ሥራዬ
ለታመነው ጌታ ምስክር የሆኑ
ከብረው ተመለሱ ለበረከት ሆኑ /2/

መነሻዬ አንተ ነህ ጉልበቴና ክብሬ
መድረሻዬም አንተ መደምደሚያ ቅጥሬ
በጽዮን ተራራ ስትገለጥ ያኔ
ነጩን ልብስ አልብሰህ አስነሳኝ ለቅኔ /2/

ጭለማዬን አስወግዶ 
ያበራልኝን አውቃለሁ
ሙሉ ሰው ነኝ ከንግዲህስ 
ስከተለው እኖራለሁ
የብርሃኔን ልዩ ውበት 
ፊት ለፊቴ ቆሞ አየሁት
ፍቅሩ ማርኮኝ 
በመቅደሱ ሰገድኩለት አመለኩት
ላመስግነው ላመስግነው ላመስግነው
ፍቅሩ ማያልቅ ነው (2)

አሳደረኝ በእቅፉ 
መጠውለጌን አለምልሞ
በመስቀል ላይ ተሰቀለ 
ዳንኩኝ እኔ እርሱ ታሞ
በማይዝለው ክንዶቹ ላይ 
እኔን በክብር እያኖረ
እንዲመቸኝ ዝቅ ብሎ 
በበረት ውስጥ እርሱ አደረ
ላመስግነው ላመስግነው ላመስግነው 
ፍቅሩ ማያልቅ ነው (2)

ቅኔ ባፈስ ምን ይደንቃል 
ደሙን በመስቀል አፍስሶ
ስለ ልጁ መዳን ብሎ 
ነፍሱን ሳይቀር ለኔ ክሶ
ፍቅር ይዞት ከጸባኦት 
በትህትና ወቶ ወርዶ 
ተቀደስኩኝ በነጩ በግ 
ቀራንዮ ጌታ ታርዶ
ላመስግነው ላመስግነው ላመስግነው 
ፍቅሩ ማያልቅ ነው (2)

አክሊል ከሶ አጠለቀ 
ግርማ ክብሩን ሁሉ ትቶ
አሻገረኝ ወደ ክብሬ 
በቅዱስ ደም እኔን ዋጅቶ
አጎንብሶ ቀና አረገኝ 
ፊቴን በጽድቅ እያበረ 
እኖራለሁ ለዘለአለም 
ካከበረኝ ጌታ ጋራ
ላመስግነው ላመስግነው ላመስግነው
ፍቅሩ ማያልቅ ነው (2)

local_csv_mezmurs.title: Ya Deha Tetara
local_csv_mezmurs.lyrics_amharic:

ይበራል በፀሎት አምላክህን ጠርተህ

ለወገን ለዘመድ ያስቸገረው መላ
ሲቀል ታየዋለህ ካነባህ በሃላ
ሳግና ንዴትህ ይቀራል ይሻራል
በአርሱ ፋንታ ሰላም ፍቅር ይከብሃል

በከንቱ መጨነቅ ራስን መጥላቱ

ሰዎች ደስ ይበለን በአምላካችን

local_csv_mezmurs.lyrics_amharic:
ሶበ ተዘከርናሃ ለጽዮን  
ሶበ ተዘከርናሃ ለጽዮን

ህየ ነበርነ ወበከይነ
እንዚራቲነ ሰቀልነ ውስተ ኲሓቲሃ

ባሰብናት ጊዜ ጽዮንን 
ባሰብናት ጊዜ ኢትዮጵያንን 
በባቢሎን ወንዞች አጠገብ 
ተቀምጠን አለቀስን 
መሰንቆአችንን ሰቀልን በዛፎቿ ላይ

                    /አዝ=====

ፅኑ መከራን ተቀበልን ተጨነቅን በፈተና

ዘምሩለት ለአምላካችሁ ቢያድናችሁ ከመከራ

እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን በመንግስቱ መርጧታል እና 
ማደሪያው ትሆነው ዘንድ ወዷታል እና
ጽዮን ሆይ እናታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም 
ጽዮን ሆይ እናታችን ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን 
አንቺን ብንረሳ ቀኛችን ትርሳን

                    /አዝ=====

የማረኩን በጦራቸው በኃይላቸው የተመኩ
በጽዮን ደጅ ያለፍርሃት የጽዮንን ክብሯን ነኩ
ይህን ያየ ከላይ ሆኖ በደመና ተሸፍኖ
ባቢሎንን አሻገረ የማረኩንን በትኖ

እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን ለመንግስቱ መርጧታል እና 
ማደሪያው ትሆነው ዘንድ ወዷታል እና
ጽዮን ሆይ እናታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም 
ጽዮን ሆይ እናታችን ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን 
አንቺን ብንረሳ ቀኛችን ትርሳን

                    /አዝ=====

ስጋችንን ይገል ዘንድ የሞት ጥላ ቢያጠላም

ቅድስት ሆይ ከባረክሽን

እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን በመንግስቱ መርጧታልና 
ማደሪያው ትሆነው ዘንድ ወዷታልና
ጽዮን ሆይ እናታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም 
ጽዮን ሆይ እናታችን ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን 
አንቺን ብንረሳ ቀኛችን ትርሳን

local_csv_mezmurs.title: Cana of Galilee
local_csv_mezmurs.lyrics_english:
Cana of Galilee /x2/ in the matrimony
Virgin we have found you with divinity 
Our Lord we have found you with our Lady

Invited were the crowds flooding through the foyer
Celebrating they ate emptied the wine chamber 
Our Holy Virgin the Mother of our Lord 
For your mediation it is you they implored

With you in attendance ashamed they will not feel
Nothing is beneath you fill with wine their barrel
“They have no wine” you said to your son our Lord 
It is our Mother we cherish and adore 

Divinity of Lord that was unveiled to us
How fortunate it was the house of Dokimas 
And today in the home of this grand unity 
Blessings have spilled to us, with His humility 

Transfigured was the wine when it was just water 
In Cana Galilee our eyes did not falter 
If we ensure that He remains within our midst
Good wine will overflow as written in the scripts

local_csv_mezmurs.title: I can't do it alone
local_csv_mezmurs.lyrics_english:
I can't do it alone, Lord be my strength /x2/
My soul longs for you, show me your truth /x2/
Help me cry and regret my sins, Lord forgive me /x2/
Give me, a repentant heart with humility

Give me tears of repentance, The Tears of St. Peter
The tears of the woman who cried, washed, Your feet with her hair
Give me the tears of King David, and his humble heart
Let me cry to cleanse my sins, give me true regret...
I can't do it alone, Lord be my strength.
Chorus….

You are my hope and my Lord, shine your guiding light
I repent, confess, all my sins, alone I cannot fight
Help me to live righteously, give me a way out
I am empty without you, send me your spirit
I can't do it alone, Lord be my strength.
Chorus….

Grant me depth in knowing you, teach me the right path
Reveal, to me Your mysteries, please strengthen my faith
You suffered on my behalf, on the cross you died
You gave me Your flesh and blood, so I can be saved
I can't do it alone, Lord be my strength.

For all that He has done I will sing hymns for Him
Within His holy church bowing for all my sins
To stand before my Lord I will rise forgiven

Through my days of despair He's my shield and armor
Find me within the church singing to the Father
Sowing my seeds of praise the heavenly gardener

Praising like King David with a harp of 10 strings
Along with the angels with joyful noise I sing
My words my sacrifice accept my offerings

To the one and true God for His name I will kneel
Giving my tithes to Him promises I'll fulfill
To enter His kingdom it is my Savior's will

Your glory I declare as I proclaim in song
Praying in your temple before the rise of dawn
Along with my fathers to you I call upon

local_csv_mezmurs.lyrics_english:

All of my torments I overcame
In front of, you tears fell down my face

Peace be unto you

You who received the crown,
